authority_boundary: This is the sole authoritative appearance contract for approved playable-character concepts. It is presentation-only and never defines combat timing, hitboxes, damage, stats, collision, or match results.

global_rules.render_style: three-head-tall chibi human-form fighter with polished semi-dimensional animation rendering and readable mobile silhouette
global_rules.age_policy: Three-head-tall chibi is an art proportion, not an age signal; every approved roster entry declares an adult gender presentation.
global_rules.body_form_policy: Human face, hands, feet, and body construction remain primary. Animal anatomy may appear only where the character entry explicitly permits it.
global_rules.motif_policy: Do not automatically add ears, tails, fur, paws, muzzles, animal legs, or other animal anatomy when an entry does not explicitly permit them.
global_rules.originality_policy: Exact animal-emblem geometry is never a required identity anchor. Future assets use original, unbranded abstract species motifs and do not reproduce a trademark or another character's identifiable symbol.
global_rules.presentation_authority: Concept art, animation, portraits, icons, and UI may consume this contract but remain non-authoritative for combat outcomes.
